claims.claim: NASDAQ ON / CIK 0001097864 identity and tradability are validated; Q2 2026 primary results and September product evidence are fresh and independent market evidence is separately classified.

factors.name: provenance and freshness
factors.basis: Primary operating evidence is current through September 2026 and independent market evidence through 2026-09-26; duplicate issuer/SEC origins are collapsed.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $1.604b, up 9% YoY; GAAP gross margin was 38.4%, operating margin 16.1%, and free cash flow $425.4m.

thesisQuality.basis: Power and sensing address durable electrification needs with improving Q2 execution, while EPP commercial-scale adoption and acquisition outcomes remain unproven.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 revenue rose 9% YoY, GAAP operating margin reached 16.1%, and free cash flow of $425.4m quadrupled YoY, though cycle volatility remains.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Current valuation is balanced-to-attractive if the earnings recovery persists, but not distressed.

catalystScore.basis: AI data-center revenue growth, EPP/GaNEXUS ramps, next earnings and the planned Synaptics transaction provide identifiable catalysts with execution uncertainty.

governancePower.basis: Improving operating leverage, repurchases and portfolio focus support capital-allocation credibility; planned acquisition and manufacturing intensity prevent stronger treatment.

alignment2036.basis: Power conversion and sensing serve AI infrastructure, automotive electrification, robotics and industrial energy efficiency across long-duration needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Core power and sensing capabilities span AI data centers, automotive and industrial infrastructure, providing multiple demand engines.

bottleneckControl.basis: Power-density and thermal constraints are real system bottlenecks and EPP targets them, but commercial-scale proof and unique control are not established.

scenarioRobustness.basis: AI infrastructure, automotive and industrial electrification diversify demand, though semiconductor cycles and technology shifts remain material.

substitutionResilience.basis: Qualification and differentiated power architectures create friction, while competing silicon, SiC, GaN and packaging solutions remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Owned manufacturing provides control but inventory, fab utilization, yield and semiconductor supply dependencies remain meaningful.

pricingPower.basis: 38.4% GAAP gross margin and improving operating leverage support moderate value capture, but cyclical competition and utilization limit scarcity-rent evidence.

riskEvidence.basis: Risks include cyclical demand, capital intensity/utilization, EPP adoption and yield uncertainty, competing architectures and acquisition execution.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Operating results and identity are primary-source supported and valuation is independently current; confidence is reduced for EPP commercial economics and future acquisition outcomes.

scoreRecord.thesis: onsemi combines improving cash generation with durable power-conversion exposure across AI, automotive and industrial markets, while cyclicality, capital intensity and unproven new-platform economics cap conviction.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: AI/power expectations outrun actual qualification, utilization and economic returns while competing architectures or a semiconductor downturn compress margins.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: November 2026 earnings and evidence of AI data-center, EPP/GaNEXUS customer ramps and Synaptics transaction progress.

risks.risk: Cyclical demand, capital intensity, new-platform adoption and acquisition execution remain material.

unknowns.unknown: Commercial-scale EPP economics and future acquisition outcomes remain uncertain.
